candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child get fever for 7 days now. The temperature dey 38.0°C. The area we dey, malaria risk dey high. Malaria test dey available and the result come out negative. The child get fever but no cough or difficult breathing. No diarrhoea. No ear wahala. No sign say the child dey convulse now or don get convulsion before. No sign say the child dey lethargic or unconscious. The child sabi drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. No generalized rash. No identified bacterial cause for the fever. No obvious cause of fever show. No measles cough, and no history say measles happen for the last 3 months. No red eyes, no runny nose, and neck no stiff.
